title: Capability Manifest
description: The single registry every caller enumerates: the board renders a button per entry, the thread exposes it as a tool, the A2A Agent Card is generated from it, and a paired device receives a subset. No caller may author an entry.

source.description: The registered directory this manifest was discovered in.

glossaryVersion.description: Domain glossary version used to normalize prompts against this manifest. Recorded with every resolution, because a synonym change silently changes future resolutions.

id.description: Dotted, stable, never renamed. A rename is a removal plus an addition.

summary.description: One line, operator-facing. Indexed for retrieval, so write it as the thing a person would say.

effectClass.description: Classified independently of any MCP annotation. Annotations are hints, never authorization.

gate.description: The confirmation the effect class requires, e.g. none, confirm, confirm + diff, confirm + reason, confirm + biometric, confirm per peer.

callers.description: Every listed caller gets the capability at once; removing it removes it from all of them. This is what makes caller parity structural rather than a discipline.

params.description: JSON Schema for the parameters. Required properties drive the underspecified verdict.

resolver.description: Names a typed entity resolver (e.g. service, port, source, peer). Entity resolution is a separate pass with its own confidence and is the most common source of the underspecified verdict.

triggers.description: Phrases a person would actually use. Indexed lexically and semantically.

negativeTriggers.description: Phrases that must NOT resolve here. A match removes the candidate outright; it is not down-weighted. 'reboot' resolving to service.restart is the near-miss that erodes trust fastest.

blastRadius.description: Drives the score penalty and the review quorum. Above single-unit the review policy escalates to a three-judge quorum.

reversible.description: Whether a receipt can carry a reverse command. Irreversible mutating capabilities should raise their gate.

personas.description: Verified personas permitted to call this. Excluded at retrieval, not at execution, and the exclusion is visible in ResolutionTrace.
